components.name: Qt 6.8.3
components.obligations: LGPL-3.0. Shipped unmodified and dynamically linked as frameworks in Contents/Frameworks, never statically linked into the DoubleSlash binary. Licence text packaged (qt-6.8.3-LGPL-3.0.txt) and surfaced in Settings > About > Third-Party Notices; upstream source published in the same places; recipients may substitute their own build per relinking-instructions.txt. This build has no webengine feature, so no Chromium ships here.

components.name: FFmpeg 7.1
components.obligations: LGPL-2.1-or-later. Qt Multimedia uses the FFmpeg backend, so the FFmpeg shared libraries ship in Contents/Frameworks, unmodified and dynamically linked. No --enable-gpl component is present.
